title: A TORN ROYAL DECREE
text: BY ORDER OF KING ALDRIC OF ALDERMERE: THE COURT MAGE MALGRIM IS RELIEVED OF HIS POST AND BARRED FROM THE TOWER OF STARS. HIS STUDIES INTO THE BINDING OF HOLY GROUND ARE FORBIDDEN. ...THE REST IS SCORCHED AWAY.

title: A GUARDSMAN'S LAST LOG
text: NINTH NIGHT. THE TOWER LIT UP GREEN AND THE KING... CROAKED. I MEAN THAT EXACTLY. WE HID HIM IN THE RUINS. STONES ROSE OUT OF THE GROUND ALL OVER THE VALE. NOTHING GROWS NEAR THEM.

title: A MERCHANT'S LEDGER
text: SOLD: 40 LANTERNS, 12 SPADES, 1 CROWN (BENT). BOUGHT: NOTHING. THE ROADS ARE CURSED AND THE GOBLINS ARE PAYING IN INKWELLS. CLOSING SHOP UNTIL THE WARD STONES FALL. IF THEY EVER DO.

title: ON THE NINTH TOWER
text: IT WAS AN OBSERVATORY ONCE: NINE FLOORS FOR THE NINE BRIGHT STARS OF ALDERMERE. MALGRIM TURNED IT INTO A LENS. EACH WARD STONE IS A FLOOR'S ANCHOR. BREAK THE ANCHORS AND THE LENS GOES DARK.

title: THE KEEPER'S PRAYER
text: LIGHT OF THE KEEP, WATCH OVER THE VALE. WHAT IS GIVEN FREELY IS NEVER SPENT. ...SCRATCHED BELOW IN A NEWER HAND: 'BUT WHAT IS TAKEN CAN BE DRAINED DRY.'

title: MALGRIM'S LETTER TO THE KING
text: ALDRIC - YOU CALL IT FORBIDDEN. I CALL IT WASTED. EVERY SHRINE IN THIS KINGDOM HUMS WITH POWER AND WE LET MONKS SING AT IT. GIVE ME THE TOWER AND I WILL GIVE YOU A KINGDOM THAT NEVER FALLS. - M.

title: A SHRINE INSCRIPTION
text: CARVED INTO THE STONE AROUND A WORN SIGIL: 'HERE THE FIRST KEEPERS BURIED THEIR LIGHT, THAT THE KEEP MIGHT NEVER GO DARK.' A THIN PURPLE ROOT HAS GROWN STRAIGHT THROUGH THE WORDS.

title: A SMUGGLER'S NOTE
text: MARGO - THE WITCHLINGS PAY TRIPLE FOR ABBEY CANDLES NOW. SAY THEY NEED THE WAX FOR 'THE VINE'. DIDN'T ASK. YOU DON'T ASK WITCHLINGS THINGS. - R.

title: A WITCHLING CATECHISM
text: WHO FEEDS THE STONE? THE VINE FEEDS THE STONE. WHO FEEDS THE VINE? THE ALTAR FEEDS THE VINE. WHO FEEDS THE ALTAR? ...THE SISTERS DID. ONCE.

title: SISTER CORA'S DIARY, I
text: THE WATER CAME UP THROUGH THE FLOOR TODAY. MOTHER SUPERIOR SAYS IT IS ONLY THE SPRING RAINS. BUT THE ALTAR CANDLES BURN PURPLE NOW, AND THE FROGS IN THE NAVE WILL NOT STOP SINGING.

title: SISTER CORA'S DIARY, II
text: MOTHER SUPERIOR WENT DOWN TO THE ALTAR TO PRAY AND DID NOT COME BACK UP. SOMETHING ENORMOUS BREATHES IN THE POOL BELOW. WE ARE LEAVING FOR THE CAMP. MAY THE LIGHT FORGIVE US.

title: THE ALTAR'S BLESSING
text: WRITTEN ON A HYMN SHEET: 'WHAT THE CURSE DRINKS, IT CANNOT KEEP. CUT THE VINE AND THE LIGHT RETURNS TO ITS HOME.' SOMEONE HAS UNDERLINED 'CUT THE VINE' THREE TIMES.

title: A HUNTER'S WARNING, NAILED TO A TREE
text: HE WAS KING ALDRIC'S MASTER OF HOUNDS ONCE. MALGRIM PROMISED HIM A HUNT THAT WOULD NEVER END, AND KEPT HIS WORD. IF YOU HEAR HOUNDS AND SEE NO DOGS, DO NOT RUN. HE LIKES IT WHEN THEY RUN.

title: WORDS CUT INTO THE ELDER'S BARK
text: THE FIRST TREE. THE DRUIDS SAID ITS HEARTWOOD REMEMBERS EVERY DAWN SINCE THE WORLD BEGAN. LATELY THE MORNINGS COME GREY AND THIN, AS IF SOMETHING UNDER THE ROOTS IS DRINKING THEM.

title: MALGRIM'S FIELD NOTE (WATER-STAINED)
text: THE WOOD IS PERFECT. SHADOW ALREADY LIVES HERE; I NEED ONLY GIVE IT TEETH. THE SEERS' LENS WOULD UNDO ALL OF IT, SO I HAVE HIDDEN IT WHERE ONLY THE HUNT WILL FIND IT.

title: A DWARVEN NOTICE, HALF MELTED
text: BY ORDER OF THE FORGE: VULK THE SALAMANDER IS NAMED FORGEMASTER, FIRST OF HIS KIND. MAY HIS HAMMER NEVER COOL. ...SOMEONE HAS SCRATCHED BENEATH IT: 'IT NEVER DID. THAT WAS THE PROBLEM.'

title: CARVED OVER THE MONASTERY DOOR
text: THE DWARVES' HEARTHSTONE HAS BURNED SINCE THE FIRST FORGE WAS LIT. IT WARMS THE WHOLE REACH. WHILE IT BURNS, NO CHILD OF CINDERREACH SHALL KNOW WINTER.

title: MALGRIM'S FIELD NOTE (SCORCHED)
text: THE SALAMANDER WANTS A FORGE THAT NEVER COOLS. I HAVE GIVEN HIM ONE, AND HE HAS GIVEN ME THE HEARTHSTONE'S FIRE. THE MINERS WILL COMPLAIN OF BURNS. LET THEM.

title: A FORGE LEDGER, CHARRED
text: DAY 1: THE NEW FORGEMASTER WORKS THROUGH THE NIGHT. DAY 9: HE WILL NOT LET THE HEARTH COOL, NOT EVEN FOR CLEANING. DAY 30: A MAN IN A GREY COAT CAME. VULK SMILED. THE HEARTHSTONE HAS NOT BEEN WARM SINCE.

title: AN ASTRONOMER'S LOG
text: NIGHT 400: THE STAR-MIRROR CAUGHT THE NORTH STAR SO BRIGHT WE READ BY IT AT MIDNIGHT. NIGHT 401: A VISITOR IN A GREY COAT ASKED TO LOOK. HE LOOKED A LONG TIME. NIGHT 402: THE MIRROR SHOWS ONLY FROST.

title: MALGRIM'S FIELD NOTE (FROST-BITTEN)
text: THE KNIGHT ISOLDE KNEELS TO NO ONE, SO I HAVE GIVEN HER SOMETHING TO KNEEL BESIDE: HER SISTER, IN ICE. SHE GUARDS THE MIRROR FOR ME NOW, AND I KEEP THE KEY TO THE THAW.

title: A NOTICE NAILED TO THE PALISADE
text: BY ORDER OF THE WARDEN: NOBODY CLIMBS THE HIGHFOLD. NOBODY GOES NEAR THE GLASS TOWER. IF YOU HEAR A WOMAN SINGING OUT ON THE ICE, THAT IS NOT A WOMAN. COME INSIDE.
